name: 頂級牌組組合 「太陽伊布・月亮伊布」
englishName: 30th Celebration Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon

description.text: 30th Celebration Premium Deck Set Espeon & Umbreon, released on 16 September 2026 for the game's 30th anniversary: two ready-built 60-card decks led by Espeon ex and Umbreon ex, both also as full-art cards, with a sliding metal box for two decks, two sheets of damage counters, Espeon and Umbreon coins, a playmat, a first-time guide and a player guide. Some cards are reprints from earlier series.

tell.text: An "MF" mark with an "F" beside it at the bottom left, and a number out of 040
